summary: Gives a benchmarking methodology for stateful NATxy gateways, building on earlier methods in RFC 2544, RFC 5180 and RFC 8219. It addresses how to apply pseudorandom port numbers from RFC 4814 when testing them.

eli5.summary: This is a test plan for checking how fast address-translating boxes are, using lots of varied connections so the test is fair.

questions: how to benchmark a nat64 gateway
benchmarking stateful nat with pseudorandom ports
